entries.zh: 六物共食；吃齐六样食物（众人合食）
entries.en: to eat the six items together; communal eating of six foods (Spanish abbreviation unexpanded)
entries.notes: 西语词头缩写（coṉs ḋs ṿos）未展开、M 栏首音节六/逐存疑，据字栏「六物食」与官话对音栏释义

entries.zh: 任凭与谁同吃；随意共食
entries.en: to eat with whomever one wishes; to eat at will
for the boy/child to eat of it at the table afterwards
entries.notes: 西语 gen/gran 存疑、汉字「掉」疑为「卓（桌）」，据 muchacho、mesa、después 推断为孩童随后上桌进食

entries.zh: 大食；食量大、大胃的人（饕客）；亦指饭厅
entries.en: to eat a lot; a great eater, glutton (comedor); dining hall
to eat until sated; to eat one's fill

entries.zh: 扫帚星；坠地之彗星；流星
entries.en: a comet that falls to earth; falling star, meteor; broom-tail comet
comet with a long tail; long-tailed star
to commit/refer the case, i.e. to send it (to court); to dispatch
entries.notes: 「cometer la causa」（移解案卷）与字栏「觧/解」相合，惟官话对音栏不协，释义部分依赖推断

entries.zh: 病人饮食；滋补浆汤、病号饭
entries.en: food given to a sick person; nourishing broth/gruel

entries.zh: 未吃完的饭菜；剩余食物（字栏「金食」字义未明）
entries.en: food not finished; leftover food (Chinese column unresolvable)
entries.notes: 字栏「金食」与 M、R 对音无从勘合且音栏多污损（T99），释义仅据西语栏「no acabada」

entries.zh: 盛设；摆出的一桌食物、齐备酒食
entries.en: food; a spread of eatables laid out together
a rich spread set out together; sumptuous fare, banquet

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕盛餞；丰盛的饯行宴席
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕 grand farewell feast, partially legible
entries.notes: 西语行逐词待核且 M 栏中段划除，据字栏「盛餞」与官话对音栏释义

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕供于亡者前的祭食；除灵（撤灵）所供之食
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕 food set before the dead; funerary offering at the removal of the spirit tablet
entries.notes: M 栏整行划除、R 栏存疑，据字栏「除靈」与西语「food placed to the dead」释义

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕皇家委任状、王命（字栏作「饗」，与词头不合）
entries.en: royal commission/real warrant (Chinese column reads a feast word; mismatch unresolved)
entries.notes: 字栏「饗」与西语「Comission Real」不相协，M、R 栏亦难勘合，释义据西语词头、存疑待核
